pages.text:
Fusion Exhaust is every reactor's unburnt fuel, ash and bred tritium together. The world keeps track of what's in it; the Tritium Plant takes it apart.
# Building it
A box of Tritium Plant Casing, 3 to 7 across and 3 to 5 tall, empty inside, the controller in a wall.

# Running it
Exhaust in through Input ports. It processes 8 mB a tick for every block inside it, at 20 FE a mB, and splits it into Deuterium (Output ports), Tritium (By-product), Helium-3 (Tails) and Helium ash (Gas Output). The tritium it holds decays into its Helium-3 tank.
# Closing the loop
Pipe Deuterium and Tritium back to the Pellet Injectors. With a whole blanket a reactor breeds a little more tritium than it burns.
